desktop.behavior: Source-space cache and original embedded bytes. Affine transforms do not resample the source. Normal duplicates share replacements; via Copy and cross-document copies use independent source IDs. Edit Contents opens a native child document; Save updates the parent and shared instances in one Undo transaction. Save As creates an independent file. Busy, changed or closed parents reject Save instead of overwriting. Source child recovery currently returns an independent document, not a restored parent link.
desktop.limits: 64 MiB per embedded source; 8,388,608 source canvas pixels; 256 MiB decoded source; eight nested decode levels. Converting layers requires unlocked roots in one parent and retained clipping bases. Painting/applying destructive adjustments requires rasterization or editing the source. Masks remain editable.
desktop.reset: Restore original source dimensions/rotation while retaining integer layer origin; exact Photoshop anchoring unqualified.

persistence.old_readers: Downloads of source-bearing documents require X-Photato-Archive-Version: 14. Older readers reject rather than discard source metadata.
persistence.psd_psb: lnk2 embedded file records plus affine SoLd; native/non-PSD-supported sources transcode to an editable PSB where supported. Native Export Contents retains original bytes. Unsupported rich source exports fail rather than flatten.
persistence.qualified: Own generated RGB8/16/32 PSD/PSB round trips; no independent Photoshop Smart Object save/reopen or pixel-match claim.

photato.source_edit: Download source, upload/open/edit/share a source document, then smartObject.replace using sourceDocumentID/sourceRevision. Desktop and API use SmartObjectIO and the prepared history transaction.
photato.state: Layers expose kind, full affine transform and nullable smartObject metadata: sourceID, SHA256 revision, filename, mediaType, byteLength, dimensions, resolution, embedded. Schema advertised by capabilities.smartObjects.layerStateSchema.

errors.409: Busy, stale, cancelled or revoked target/source
errors.422: Unsupported source/operation, protection or native validation

adobe.scope: Add embedded smart_object_layer with operation.placement.type=top; edit an existing embedded object by unique name or signed32-bit PSD id. Resolve smartObject.smartObjectFile.source.url via the existing enabled resource job transport. autoResize defaults true and resizes source canvas/dpi; false keeps replacement dimensions. Changes affect the targeted instance. transformMode none/fit/fill, visibility, clipping, supported dropShadow/protection fields.
